remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath first-floor condo in the heart of Glenbrook! Step inside to a bright, open living space that feels both spacious and comfortable, offering plenty of room to relax and entertain. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day on your private patio, then take a short stroll to the community pool for some fun in the sun. With an assigned parking spot and a dedicated storage unit, everyday convenience is built right in. Located close to shopping, dining, transportation, and all that Stamford has to offer, this condo is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy easy, low-maintenance living in a great location!
